description: This file contains Swagger API documentation classes for the Account Number Formats API in the Apache Fineract project. It defines data schemas for API responses and requests related to account number format configurations.

classes.name: AccountNumberFormatsApiResourceSwagger
classes.description: Contains nested static classes defining Swagger schemas for the Account Number Formats API responses and requests.

classes.name: GetAccountNumberFormatsResponse
classes.description: Schema class for API response containing a list of account number formats.

classes.name: GetAccountNumberFormatsIdResponse
classes.description: Schema class representing the details of a specific account number format identified by ID.

classes.name: GetAccountNumberFormatsResponseTemplate
classes.description: Schema class for the response template providing options for account types and prefix types.

classes.name: PostAccountNumberFormatsRequest
classes.description: Schema class for the request to create a new account number format.

classes.name: PostAccountNumberFormatsResponse
classes.description: Schema class for the response after creating a new account number format.

classes.name: PutAccountNumberFormatsRequest
classes.description: Schema class for the request to update an existing account number format.

classes.name: PutAccountNumberFormatsResponse
classes.description: Schema class for the response after updating an account number format, contains nested changes schema.

classes.name: PutAccountNumberFormatschangesSwagger
classes.description: Nested schema class within the PUT response detailing specific changes made.

classes.name: DeleteAccountNumberFormatsResponse
classes.description: Schema class for the response after deleting an account number format.
